definitions.explanation: Describes something that branches out into many different areas or directions. Almost always used in the fixed expression 多岐にわたる (to span many areas). Literally means 'many branches' (of a path).

examples.japanese: {議論|ぎろん}は{多岐|たき}にわたった。
examples.english: The discussion covered a wide range of topics.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{活動|かつどう}は{多岐|たき}にわたる。
examples.english: His activities span a wide range of fields.

examples.japanese: {被害|ひがい}は{多岐|たき}にわたっており、{全容|ぜんよう}の{把握|はあく}にはまだ{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: The damage is wide-ranging, and it will still take time to grasp the full picture.

notes:
{多岐|たき} literally means "many branches" (of a road or path). It is almost exclusively used in the fixed expression {多岐|たき}にわたる.

KEY EXPRESSION:
{多岐|たき}にわたる: to span many areas, to be wide-ranging
- {多岐|たき}にわたる{分野|ぶんや}: fields spanning many areas
- {多岐|たき}にわたる{問題|もんだい}: problems covering many areas

REGISTER:
Formal and written. Common in news articles, reports, academic writing, and business documents. In casual conversation, {幅広|はばひろ}い or いろいろな would be preferred.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {多岐|たき}にわたる: spanning many branches/areas (formal, fixed expression)
- {幅広|はばひろ}い: wide-ranging, broad (more general, less formal)
- {多方面|たほうめん}: many directions/fields (similar formality)
